newsitem.title: INDIA: India says removes cold storage controls.
newsitem.headline: India says removes cold storage controls.

text.p: India said on Friday it had removed licensing and price controls governing cold storage by repealing a 1980 order.
"The Ministry of Rural Areas and Employment has repealed the Cold Storage Order of 1980," a government statement said.
It said this was intended to remove licensing, price controls and allotment of cold storage space.
"The repeal of the order is yet another step in the government's attempt to develop a free market economy by way of liberalisation and decontrol of the existing procedures," the statement said.

It said the 1980 order had inhibited the growth of cold storages as licenses were needed to set up new cold storages and expand old ones. The order also imposed price controls by way of storage and rental charges.
